Found: Woman last seen in Ang Mo Kio on Nov 8
Missing: Girl, 13, last seen in Sengkang on Nov 8

headline: Singapore Authorities Report Multiple Recent Missing Person Cases
metaDescription: Singapore authorities have issued reports regarding several missing persons cases across different neighborhoods in the city over the past few days.
aiSummaryBullets: A 13-year-old girl was reported missing after she was last seen in Sengkang on November 8.
A woman last seen near Kebun Baru Food Centre in Ang Mo Kio on November 8 has been located.
A man last seen in the vicinity of Yishun Avenue 2 on November 8 has been found.
aiContextParagraph: The Singaporean authorities recently addressed a series of missing person reports involving individuals across various residential areas. On November 8, a man last seen wearing a light green shirt and blue shorts near Yishun Avenue 2 was reported missing and has since been located. Similarly, a woman named Ng Ai Choo, who was last seen on November 8 near the Kebun Baru Food Centre in Ang Mo Kio, has also been found. Meanwhile, local reports indicate that a 13-year-old girl is currently missing. She was last observed in the Sengkang area on November 8 and was wearing black shorts, black slides, and a white t-shirt at the time. These incidents are being monitored by the local community as authorities continue to manage welfare and safety alerts in these districts.
whyItIsViral: The cluster is trending due to heightened public interest in safety and missing persons reports, as reflected by an 84/100 search signal.
